meta.scene: Headlights on. Tape in. Press play.
The ocean on the left, the whole sleeping city in the mirror.
Red and blue lights, far behind. Then closer.
Foot down. The palm trees blur into one long stripe.
Lost them in the tunnel. Breathing again.
A roadblock at the bridge. No way back.
Through the gap in the barrier, with an inch to spare.
Engine off, coasting downhill in the dark.
Key change: the sky starts going pink.
